brief:
Palestinian leader Omar Assaf, coordinator of the Popular Conference for Palestinians-14 Million, announced plans to participate in upcoming legislative elections through a national alliance, the Shehab Wire reported. Assaf said his movement is seeking to unite multiple Palestinian factions under a single electoral banner.

The effort reflects broader attempts within Palestinian political circles to consolidate support ahead of the parliamentary vote. Assaf emphasized the group's commitment to building a wider coalition that could strengthen their electoral position and representation in the legislature.
